components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Wraps a set of expansion panels so that opening one automatically closes any other open panel.

components.name: app-bar
components.title: App Bar
components.description: App bars are headers used to display branding, navigation, and actions at the top of an application.

components.name: app-launcher
components.title: App Launcher
components.description: The app launcher lets a user switch between related apps, browse every available app, and jump to custom links, from the app bar's end slot.

components.name: app-layout
components.title: App Layout
components.description: The app layout provides a complete application shell with an app bar, responsive navigation drawer, and a body area for page content.

components.name: autocomplete
components.title: Autocomplete
components.description: Autocomplete components provide real-time typeahead suggestions as users type in a text field.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: A non-interactive circle that represents an entity — with an image, initials, or an icon.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: Badges display small amounts of non-interactive information like counts, status indicators, or notifications.

components.name: banner
components.title: Banner
components.description: Banners inform users of important, page-level information — such as errors, warnings, or success messages — without interrupting their workflow.

components.name: busy-indicator
components.title: Busy Indicator
components.description: A busy indicator blocks interaction with a fullscreen or inline region while a longer-running process completes.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: Buttons allow users to take actions and make choices with a single tap.

components.name: button-area
components.title: Button Area
components.description: Makes an entire region of content — like a card — behave as a single clickable control, backed by a real button or link underneath.

components.name: button-toggle
components.title: Button Toggle
components.description: Button toggles allow users to select from a group of choices with single or multiple selection.

components.name: calendar
components.title: Calendar
components.description: A flexible calendar component for date selection with support for single dates, ranges, multiple selections, and extensive customization options.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: Cards group related content and actions about a single topic into one surface.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: Checkboxes allow for selecting multiple options from a set.

components.name: chip
components.title: Chip
components.description: A compact, interactive element that represents an entity, action, or attribute with support for selection, removal, and various styling options.

components.name: chip-field
components.title: Chip Field
components.description: A specialized input field that lets users create and manage a collection of chips representing freeform text values or selections.

components.name: circular-progress
components.title: Circular Progress
components.description: Circular progress indicators display progress along a circular track, for both determinate and indeterminate waits.

components.name: color-picker
components.title: Color Picker
components.description: An interactive color selection component with support for multiple color formats (hex, RGB, HSV) and optional opacity control.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date Picker
components.description: A date input component with an integrated calendar popup for selecting single dates.

components.name: date-range-picker
components.title: Date Range Picker
components.description: A date input component with an integrated calendar popup for selecting date ranges with separate "from" and "to" date values.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: Dialogs are modal windows that interrupt the user to convey critical information or request a decision.

components.name: divider
components.title: Divider
components.description: A thin line that visually separates groups of related content, horizontally or vertically.

components.name: drawer
components.title: Drawer
components.description: Drawers support persistent navigation or supplementary content pinned to the left or right edge of the screen.

components.name: expansion-panel
components.title: Expansion Panel
components.description: Expansion panels show summary content and reveal additional detail on tap, for progressive disclosure inside a card, list, or table.

components.name: fab
components.title: Floating Action Button
components.description: Floating action buttons represent the single most important action on a page, positioned above other content to draw attention to it.

components.name: file-picker
components.title: File Picker
components.description: Lets a user upload one or more files via drag-and-drop or a system file chooser, with visual cues for valid and invalid drops.

components.name: icon
components.title: Icon
components.description: Icons render a registered SVG from the Tyler Forge icon library, or a custom source, to represent information or reinforce an action.

components.name: icon-button
components.title: Icon Button
components.description: Icon buttons are buttons that contain only an icon, and are used to represent actions or commands.

components.name: inline-message
components.title: Inline Message
components.description: Inline messages provide contextual feedback about a specific action or state, inside the component they refer to.

components.name: key
components.title: Key
components.description: Keys label the meaning of colors or values in a chart or data visualization, such as which color in a grouped meter represents which series.

components.name: keyboard-shortcut
components.title: Keyboard Shortcut
components.description: Attaches a keyboard shortcut to an element, or the whole page, without any visible UI of its own.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: Labels attach an accessible caption and Forge typography to a specific set of label-aware Forge components, in place of a plain HTML label element.

components.name: label-value
components.title: Label Value
components.description: Label values display a label and value pair in a compact format with the proper typography and spacing styles applied.

components.name: linear-progress
components.title: Linear Progress
components.description: Linear progress indicators display progress by animating along a horizontal track, for both determinate and indeterminate waits.

components.name: list
components.title: List
components.description: Lists present a vertical, scannable group of related items, from plain text rows to full navigation menus.

components.name: menu
components.title: Menu
components.description: Menus display a list of contextual actions or options in a popup, triggered from a button, icon, or list item.

components.name: meter
components.title: Meter
components.description: Meters display a scalar value within a known range, using color to signal whether it's optimal, suboptimal, or least optimal.

components.name: page-state
components.title: Page State
components.description: Page state displays a full-height message — for an empty result, an error, or general information — with an optional graphic and actions.

components.name: paginator
components.title: Paginator
components.description: The paginator divides a logically sorted collection into pages, so users can navigate and mentally orient within the set.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: A popover floats content above the page, positioned relative to the trigger element that anchors it.

components.name: radio
components.title: Radio
components.description: The Forge Radio component is used to create a form input where only one out of a set of values should be selected.

components.name: scaffold
components.title: Scaffold
components.description: The scaffold lays out a header, scrollable body, and footer using named slots, for full pages or smaller sections alike.

components.name: secret
components.title: Secret
components.description: Conceals sensitive content with a blur, mask, or noise effect, revealing it on user interaction.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: Select components are comboboxes that present a list of options to users for single or multi-selection.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: A skeleton screen is a low-fidelity placeholder that gradually loads into real content, giving users a visual cue that content is on its way.

components.name: skip-link
components.title: Skip Link
components.description: Skip links let a user bypass repetitive content and navigate directly to a section of the page, meeting WCAG's bypass-blocks requirement.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: Sliders allow users to make selections from a range of values.

components.name: split-button
components.title: Split Button
components.description: Splits an action into two parts — typically a primary action and a secondary action that opens a menu or performs an alternative action.

components.name: split-view
components.title: Split View
components.description: Split view lays out two or more panels side by side, at least one of which a user can resize by dragging.

components.name: stack
components.title: Stack
components.description: A layout utility that manages spacing and alignment of its immediate children along a single vertical or horizontal axis.

components.name: stepper
components.title: Stepper
components.description: Steppers break a multi-step process into a numbered sequence, showing progress toward completion.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: Switches toggle the state of a single setting on or off.

components.name: table
components.title: Table
components.description: Tables display sets of data in sortable, filterable, selectable rows and columns, configured through data and column definitions.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Tabs organize and switch between groups of related content that sit at the same level of hierarchy.

components.name: text-field
components.title: Text Field
components.description: An input field used to capture user text input, with an optional label, helper text, and validation state.

components.name: time-picker
components.title: Time Picker
components.description: A time input component with an integrated dropdown for selecting time values, with support for various formats, masking, and validation.

components.name: timeline
components.title: Timeline
components.description: Timelines display a list of events in chronological order, showing the sequence and relationship between events over time.

components.name: timestamp
components.title: Timestamp
components.description: Timestamps display a formatted, localized date, time, or duration value using the native time element.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: Toasts are brief, non-modal notifications that confirm a user's action and disappear automatically.

components.name: toolbar
components.title: Toolbar
components.description: Toolbars align a title and actions inside a full-width container, most often as a header or footer for another surface.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: Tooltips display a short text label for an element when the user hovers, focuses, or long-presses it.

components.name: tree
components.title: Tree
components.description: Trees are interactive lists that allow users to navigate through hierarchical data.

components.name: view-switcher
components.title: View Switcher
components.description: A view switcher shows one of several views at a time, animating between them along a shared axis as the active index changes.
